name: Habibi & Hawara Landstraße
address: Platz der Sozialen Sicherheit, Kundmanngasse 21-27, 1030 Wien

sources.says: Only remaining restaurant; Mo & Feiertag Ruhetag, Di–Fr 11:30–15:00, Sa/So Brunch 9:00–15:00; closed 21.12.2026–8.1.2027; tel 01/710 87 27; 'PROSECCO &/oder LIMONADEN FREE FLOW'. No halal mention.
Food menu: 'Dienstag bis Freitag 11:30 - 17:30'; chicken is 'steirisches Hühnerfleisch', burger Bio-Galloway beef; no halal mention.
Drinks card Landstraße: Mimosa, Aperol Spritz, Hugo, Gin Tonic, wines, spritzers.
Brunch buffet €29.90 with 'Käse- und Wurstplatten' (meat not stated).
ORF (Jan 2023): insolvency; locations Wipplingerstraße, Nordbahnviertel, Siebensterngasse and Seestadt given up.
vienna.at (2023): Habibi & Hawara insolvent, closes most Vienna restaurants; only Landstraße continues.

notes: Only surviving Habibi & Hawara restaurant (run by The Good Life Hospitality Group). No halal claim anywhere; chicken is Styrian chicken; wide alcohol offer; brunch has Wurstplatten of unstated meat → pork null. Hours conflict: homepage Di–Fr 11:30–15:00 vs PDF menu Di–Fr 11:30–17:30 – homepage used. Probably not halal-friendly; owner to decide.
why_halal_friendly: Weak: oriental-Viennese kitchen run as a refugee social business, but no halal claim and alcohol served – listed only because the chain is in our data.
